detailed_descriptions.en: You expected a quiet little Halloween shop. You open the door to find its contents scattered everywhere. Time to put things right—and perhaps find out what happened. An armful at a time Pick up scattered treasures and return them to their shelves. From curious potions and tiny familiars to pumpkins, sweets and autumn flowers, there’s a whole shop of spooky little things to sort. Enjoy the satisfaction of everything finding its place, at your own pace. A little out of the ordinary Some things need more than tidying away. Follow strange clues, discover the shop’s secrets, and find a friend who may know something about the mess. Settle in. There’s no timer, and you might have company.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
You expected a quiet little Halloween shop. You open the door to find its contents scattered everywhere. Time to put things right—and perhaps find out what happened.

An armful at a time

Pick up scattered treasures and return them to their shelves. From curious potions and tiny familiars to pumpkins, sweets and autumn flowers, there’s a whole shop of spooky little things to sort. Enjoy the satisfaction of everything finding its place, at your own pace.

A little out of the ordinary

Some things need more than tidying away. Follow strange clues, discover the shop’s secrets, and find a friend who may know something about the mess.

Settle in. There’s no timer, and you might have company.
